Enjoy this super hit song from the 1984 movie Kasam Paida Karne Wale Ki starring Mithun Chakraborty, Smita Patil, Salma Agha in the lead role. enjoy this dance song.
Song: Ye Raat Mein Jo Maza Hai
Movie: Kasam Paida Karne Wale Ki (1984)
Actor(s): Mithun Chakraborty, Salma Agha
Singer(s): Salma Agha
Music: Bappi Lahiri
Lyricist: Anjaan
